comparison.objective: Clip a wafer to an e-beam sample plate and load it face down into a load lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Select clips, center a wafer, tighten several screws through regrasp strokes, flip an assembly, and operate a chamber.
comparison.success_condition: Clips fall within torque-angle windows, wafer is loaded face down, and door is safely shut and locked.
comparison.reason: It shares screwdriver turning and angular windows, but no concentric locknut counterholding or motion-stop retention is tested.
